recommended_next_phase: Independent verification of HRWP-001 (docs/contracts/HATP_REMOTE_WEBAUTHN_PROVIDER_CONTRACT.md) before any implementation. Do not start a WebAuthn server, RP-ID/DNS/TLS provisioning, or any implementation work until that independent verification is complete.
summary: Contract/architecture-freeze phase, following Phase 149O.20L.7O.2N.6's recommendation to freeze the remote-WebAuthn provider contract and ceremony architecture before any implementation. Read fresh hatp_fido2_provider.py, hatp_providers.py, hatp_hardware_credentials.py, hatp_bootstrap.py, hatp_signing_ceremony.py, and the four existing frozen HATP contracts (HHCE-001 v1.1, HPSE-001 v1.1, HSCE-001 v1.3, HBDC-001 v1.2) to ground every architectural decision in current code. Central finding: the existing local FIDO2 provider's signing ceremony already verifies authenticatorData||SHA-256(clientDataJSON) -- the same construction a browser WebAuthn getAssertion produces -- narrowing the raw-CTAP-vs-WebAuthn gap the prior phase flagged to origin/RP-ID enforcement only, not cryptographic incompatibility. Froze HRWP-001 v1.0 (docs/contracts/HATP_REMOTE_WEBAUTHN_PROVIDER_CONTRACT.md, 68 requirements, HRWP-REQ-001 through HRWP-REQ-068, no gaps, no duplicates): a new, distinct provider_profile value (HATP_HARDWARE_PROVIDER_V1_REMOTE_WEBAUTHN) required because Fido2HardwareProvider.verify() already fail-closes on provider_profile mismatch; registration/assertion evidence mappings onto the existing HardwareCredentialRecord schema requiring zero HHCE-001 schema changes; SignerRecord/DeploymentBinding impact confirmed nil (HPSE-001/HBDC-001 unamended, still exactly one DeploymentBinding per repository_id); explicit, named-but-unresolved RP-ID/HTTPS/TLS infrastructure requirements left for the next phase (no literal hostname/CA/topology selected); challenge/session field set, one-time-use replay protection, single-use session binding; EXPLICIT_SIGNER credential-selection policy matching the existing DeploymentBinding single-selector model; Model-B client-trust boundary preserved (hac-dell remains authoritative for every governance-sensitive fact); and a named, explicitly-deferred HSCE-001-companion-contract gap for remote-ceremony evidence-capture orchestration, disclosed as future work rather than concealed. USB-over-IP classified EXPERIMENTAL/NOT PRIMARY. Existing local raw FIDO2 path retained unmodified -- hybrid means additive. 17 new disposable tests (contract structural completeness plus non-regression of hatp_fido2_provider.py's RP-ID/origin constants, HATP_HARDWARE_PROVIDER_V1, and HardwareCredentialRecord's field set), all passing. No production source changed. No makeCredential/getAssertion against real hardware anywhere.
